newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank/Portugal leaves key rates unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Portugal leaves key rates unchanged.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal said it left its key absorption rate, used to drain funds from the money market, and its emergency lending rate unchanged on the eve of a new central bank reserve accounting period.
Its draining rate remains at 6.20 percent and its emergency lending rate at 8.30 percent.
The central bank also offered to inject 10 billion escudos of seven-day funds into the money market in a variable rate repurchase pact effective tomorrow. Bids must be submitted by 1515 GMT today.
